CustomField.description: Stable external identifier for the Donor Gift Summary. Used to upsert historical / legacy giving totals from prior systems (archived CRM, spreadsheet migration, data lake) into this record. Format is free-form but should match the External_Id__c on the parent Account (e.g., LEGACY-CRM-A00123) so cross-system reconciliation stays traceable. Not required on records created by NPC rollups — those are keyed on DonorId.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: External identifier from the legacy or source system this donor's historical giving was imported from. Used to upsert legacy totals without overwriting standard NPC rollups.
CustomField.label: External Id
